verification_scope: New standard-library custody decoder, whole-packet verifier and tests; exact public wrapper and original payload identities only

observed_runs.outcome: JSON parsing the Git-blob connector response failed because the connector returned decoded UTF-8 wrapper text, not raw Git REST JSON. No files had been written. The decoder pins the recovered complete original UTF-8 bytes before interpretation.
Expected missing-gate failures plus one symlink test setup error: the placeholder returned no payloads, so the setup tried to unlink a nonexistent receipt.
An explicit assertion on the missing receipt converted the setup error into an intended feature-missing assertion failure before decoder implementation.

observed_runs.outcome: Final readback rejected a generated manifest with a literal backslash-n terminator; its generator also used literal backslash-zero instead of the NUL byte in Git framing. Both transient metadata defects were corrected with explicit byte/newline construction. Original payload bytes were unchanged. The final verifier checks known payload Git identities and every manifest identity.
